desc: Enjoy power and consistency with the 3,200-watt PowerPlus® Element
hl: With five elements, this cooktop is designed to handle all of your cooking needs, including our powerful 3,200-Watt EvenTemp™ Element, a versatile 2-in-1 Dual Element, and convenient Keep Warm Zone.
Sleek LED knobs illuminate when in use, so you always know which element is on.

We promise that your new 30" Frigidaire electric cooktop will fit your existing countertop cutout of the same width and configuration, or we will reimburse you for cabinet modification costs up to $100.
Experience fast, even heat with our 3,200-Watt EvenTemp™ element—reducing hot and cold spots for consistent results every time.
Expands from 9" to 12" to accommodate larger pots or cookware.
Easily wipe away spills from the smooth glass cooktop.
